audit.whatIsWrong: 'diff' says EVEN while diffRating (8/10), breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t all say Hard — the same split found on the vayne and yasuo pages.
audit.why: The enum is the outlier against three prose fields, and enum edits are length-exempt. The seven chart rows agree across packet.levelChart, full phases[].side and content win[] (Yone throughout), so no rows are flipped and no mirror conflict is introduced.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to trade 'when his E is on cooldown' but never says how long that is. Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — a 22-second window at rank 1 is the whole early-game punish.
audit.why: The approved bar wants real cooldowns where they make advice concrete; 'his E is down' means nothing without the number. Spirit Cleave's 14s and Fate Sealed's 120/100/80s are the other two timers, and all four spike entries are present with correct 'when' values.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed is described as 'a point-blank knockup' that 'juggles you out of your R totem' in spikes[1], mid, whys[4] and wants.foe[2]. Riot's text says he blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls all enemies hit toward him — it is a 1000-range pull, not a point-blank knockup, and nothing in it makes you airborne. The mirror audit (yone__locke) already removed the same airborne claim from his side.
audit.why: The invented knockup drives the whole level-6 plan on this page ('your totem does nothing while airborne'), which is advice built on a mechanic Yone does not have. What is real and unstated: Fate Sealed is a blink and Mortal Steel's third hit is a dash, so Purgatory's grounding denies both.
audit.corrected: Fate Sealed = blink behind the line, pull inward. Purgatory's grounding is the answer, and it must land before he commits.
sources: enemyKit R text and dash flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Locke's Q 'Ritual Nails'; Riot's text says 'a set of Soul Nails'.
audit.why: The yone-side mirror explicitly left this unverified rather than renaming, so I matched it to keep the two directions identical. Recorded as unverified.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay red. His Q knockup into E soul-dash lets him all-in and escape, and at 6 Fate Sealed catches your W commit and juggles you out of your R totem. Only trade when his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay red. His Q knockup into E soul-dash lets him all-in and escape, and at 6 Fate Sealed pulls you back into his combo. Land Purgatory first — grounded, his R blink and Q dash die. Trade while his E is down.

edits.before: Yone's first item spikes both his AD and AP scaling; his E return-dash bails him out of your all-in and lets him re-engage when your cooldowns are down.
edits.after: Yone's first item spikes both his AD and AP scaling; Soul Unbound (E) bails him out of your all-in on a 22s cooldown at rank 1, so punish the gap between casts.

edits.before: Fate Sealed you out of your R totem zone
edits.after: Pull you back in with Fate Sealed (R)

notes: Fate Sealed is a pull, not a knockup — the page's entire level-6 plan rested on an airborne state Yone cannot inflict.
